_: Text dictionary for the Araqs number valuation engine, English. Engine 5.0, search 1.2 (11.09.2026). Do not change the keys on the left. Placeholders in curly braces are filled in by the engine. If a key is missing, the engine returns the code itself, so a missing translation is visible immediately.
pattern._: --- patterns: what the engine found in the digits ---
run.4.end.lucky: four {digit}s in a row at the very end of the number
run.4.end: four {digit}s in a row at the end of the number
run.4.cross: four {digit}s in a row continuing into the operator code
run.3.strong: three {digit}s in a row in a strong position
run.2.end: the pair {digit}{digit} at the end of the number
seq.6: a full run of {n} consecutive digits ({text})
seq.5: a run of five consecutive digits ({text})
seq.4: a run of four consecutive digits ({text})
block.pair.x3: the pair “{block}” repeated {reps} times in a row
block.triple.x2.clean: the triple “{block}” repeated twice, with only {distinct} distinct digits in the number
zeros.tail.4plus: {n} zeros at the end of the number
zeros.tail.3.clean: three trailing zeros with few distinct digits
zeros.tail.3: three zeros at the end of the number
zeros.tail.2: two zeros at the end of the number
pairs.seq: pairs of identical digits in a row, and the pairs themselves run in sequence ({text})
pairs.4: four pairs of identical digits in a row
pairs.3: three pairs of identical digits in a row
pairs.2: two pairs of identical digits in a row
rhythm.4plus: the digit {digit} appears on every other position, {n} times
distinct.le2: the whole number uses only {distinct} distinct digits
distinct.3: the number uses only 3 distinct digits
extra._: --- additional features: everything else the number has ---
extra.zeros: {n} zero in the number — a round digit
{n} zeros in the number — round digits
extra.pairsAligned: {n} pair of identical digits by grouping ({text})
{n} pairs of identical digits by grouping ({text})
extra.rhythm: the digit {digit} appears on every other position, {n} time
the digit {digit} appears on every other position, {n} times
extra.distinct: only {n} distinct digit in the whole number
only {n} distinct digits in the whole number
note._: --- notes shown on the listing card ---
note.crossesCode: The pattern continues into the operator code — such numbers are rarer and valued higher.
note.clean: The number uses only {distinct} distinct digits — a very clean pattern.
note.operatorAboveMarket: A new number of this category costs more at {operator} than such numbers usually sell for on the market.
note.endsLast: The pattern ends on the last digit of the number, which makes it easier to remember.
note.operatorFromCode: The operator was inferred from the code ({operator}) — check with the seller, the number may have been ported.
note.askHeldOver: Ask the seller whether they have held the number for more than two years: with Viva that changes the transfer fee from the full category price to 500 ֏.
note.homoglyphs: The input contained letters that look like digits and were read as digits. Please check that the number was recognised correctly.
note.landline: This is a landline number. The scale is built for mobile numbers, so the estimate is approximate.
note.notPublishable: No pattern found — numbers like this are not published on the site.
fee._: --- how the transfer fee was calculated ---
fee.plain: a number with no pattern — no category fee applies
fee.viva.free: Viva: the seller has held the number for more than two years, so only the fixed {fixed} ֏ applies and the category price is waived.
fee.viva.pending: Viva: the seller has held the number for less than two years — {fixed} ֏ plus the full category price.
fee.team: Team: {fixed} ֏ plus the full category price, with no exceptions.
fee.ucom.flat: Ucom: a flat {flat} ֏ for Silver and Bronze.
fee.ucom.half: Ucom: half of the category price.
fee.unknownOperator: Operator unknown — the estimate uses the Viva price list.
price.rangeExplained: This is the full price for the buyer, transfer fee included. The fee depends on the operator and is taken out of this amount — which is why sellers on different operators end up with different sums.
error._: --- when the number could not be read ---
error.notRecognized: Number not recognised — eight significant digits are needed, separated only by spaces, dots or hyphens.
error.multipleNumbers: The line contains several different numbers ({numbers}) — please leave one.
fee.viva.unknownHeld: Viva: {fixed} ֏ plus the category price. If the seller has held the number for more than two years, the category price is waived — check this with the seller.
search.hint.start: Looking for numbers that start with “{mask}”.
search.hint.middle: Looking for numbers with “{mask}” in the middle.
search.hint.end: Looking for numbers that end with “{mask}”.
search.hint.count: Looking for numbers where the digit {digit} appears at least {min} times, anywhere in the number.
search.empty: Enter some digits or choose a condition.
search.badChars: The query contains characters that are not allowed. You can enter digits, “?” for any single digit and “*” for any number of digits.
search.tooLong: The query is too long — a number has eight significant digits.
search.similar: No exact matches. Here are numbers that differ by one digit:
note.feeEatsPrice: {operator} will keep more than half the price as a transfer fee, leaving the seller little. Check how long the number has been held: with Viva the fee drops to 500 ֏ after two years.
